items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: A few of them musicians and Humpily Got It. His cornet player, piano player. He played banjo, guitar, little. Ask him who he played with. Who did he play with? Who, Humpily?

ctx.x: Well, was this after World War I or before?

Was this after World War I or before? After World War I, way after World War I. Was it? When we first started making banjos, you know, in the orchestra, taking music, that's when it come out. That's when we start to, you know, start to make ninth chords. But did you ever hear that, Humpily Got It? Never heard it, man. Oh, you're a good corner. You're a good corner. Who? Humpily Got It.
